peopleAlsoAsk.question: Do you need a parking disc in France?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
Parking rules

 Parking is free on roads with a dotted white line or no markings. Blue zone parking areas allow free parking for a designated time. You'll need to display a parking disc in your vehicle window showing your arrival time.
